about: The graduate bar (plan §7b, comms/gradbar.py, 2026-10-17): roasts from the coaching calls where a student's email was rewritten by the coach. Each item is turned into an engine case holding only what the student knew (the situation and the student's own email; the coach's rewrite was not read while writing them), so the engine drafts from the same facts and the pairwise judge compares its draft with the coach's rewrite and with the student's email. The texts themselves stay in the mined calls (idx = item index in verified.json). Set 'ai' is AI, coding and software (the agency's niche); set 'tech' is consumer tech, the closest niche the calls have, reported apart. Placeholders such as [Brand] are the student's own and are kept. Item 7078 was left out: its coach rewrite is quoted in the skill. These items are held out of the example bank (example_bank.build). Thread messages in 9172 and 9871 are fixtures written for the case, not mailbox data. Items with "bar": "good" (v2, 2026-10-18) are student emails a coach called good: the case is written from that email (no rewrite exists), and the engine is judged against the email itself, a competent graduate's whole email with the same facts; their threads (3516, 7787) are fixtures too, and a missing 'today' is the call's date.
